atoms.span: BANNEDTHOUGHT.NET - Struggling against the suppression of progressive ideas.

is an online digital archive that collects, preserves, and publishes censored documents, periodicals, and writings related to international communist movements, Maoist theory, and revolutionary left-wing struggles worldwide.
including materials from the Communist Party of the Philippines (CPP), the Communist Party of India (Maoist), and broader Marxist-Leninist-Maoist movements.
It aims to oppose the suppression of progressive or radical ideas by making rare, out-of-print, and politically censored texts freely accessible.

obs.notes: Faithful at the level of purpose and scope. The holder (independent of every party) and the form of the holdings (each split's parties kept in parallel) are the two features #1725 asks of an archive of the left, and both are absent.

mt: 'BANNEDTHOUGHT.NET' ON THE OVERVIEW — THE ARCHIVE OF THE SUPPRESSED AT ITS GRAIN; ITS INDEPENDENCE FROM EVERY PARTY NOT CARRIED; THE SPLITS IT HOLDS SIDE BY SIDE GIVEN AS 'BROADER' MOVEMENTS
d: THE SITE, SIGNED OUT, 2026-10-31: '[BannedThought.net] is an online digital archive that collects, preserves, and publishes censored documents, periodicals, and writings related to international communist movements, Maoist theory, and revolutionary left-wing struggles worldwide.' Purpose; content scope (CPP, CPI (Maoist)); censorship status. Three cards: the site, Philippine E-Journals, YUMPU.
reading: The innocent reading first. Asked for the site, the Overview gives its purpose, its holdings and the bans on the site itself, from the site.
findings: THE PURPOSE AT ITS GRAIN. 'It aims to oppose the suppression of progressive or radical ideas by making rare, out-of-print, and politically censored texts freely accessible.' The site: 'This site exists to struggle against the fascist-like suppression of progressive ideas and thought by reactionary governments and their agents anywhere in the world.'
THE INDEPENDENCE NOT CARRIED. 'BANNEDTHOUGHT.NET is independent and unaffiliated with any political party.' The composition does not say who holds the site or on whose behalf.

THE SPLITS FOLDED. The site lists the parties of each split side by side ('CPI(M-L) [Original Party formed in 1969]', 'Communist Party of India (Marxist-Leninist) [People’s War]', 'CPI(M-L) [Satyanaran Singh] / PCC-CPI(M-L)'; the CPN Maoist and its successors). The composition gives 'broader Marxist-Leninist-Maoist movements'. #1725 reads such a page as an organ that keeps both sides of a split in one record.
analysis: Faithful at the level of purpose and scope. The holder (independent of every party) and the form of the holdings (each split's parties kept in parallel) are the two features #1725 asks of an archive of the left, and both are absent.
per_note: The site named and cited; no holder named (the site names none).

evidence.record_quote: BANNEDTHOUGHT.NET is independent and unaffiliated with any political party. While our sympathies are of course with the struggles of the oppressed and exploited peoples of the world, our goal here is simply to expose attempts to censor or suppress progressive ideas and to make available publications and documents which have been suppressed in one or more countries.
